title: Record a run event input
description: A record of a run, from the runtime or written by the daemon itself (kind starts with `runbook.`): keep it, unchanged, under its sequence number (per run, only grows) and its position (per daemon, minted by the daemon, only grows over all runs). The handler fills `position` and `session_id` (copied from the run). An event for a run that has ended, was cancelled or failed to start is refused.

sdc.daemon.EventKind.title: EventKind
sdc.daemon.EventKind.description: Open text: the kind of the runtime's run-log line, copied. Events the daemon writes itself have a kind that starts with `runbook.` (runbook.submitted, runbook.cancel-requested, runbook.start-failed). Not a closed set.

sdc.daemon.RunId.title: RunId
sdc.daemon.RunId.description: The id of a run. The daemon mints it (a UUID, version 7) in the HTTP handler and returns it in the answer to the submit; the handler fills the `run_id` input of SubmitRun and a client never chooses it. The state directory of the run is named after it. A run id that is already taken cannot occur, because the daemon mints it; the specification has no refusal for it.

sdc.daemon.SessionId.title: SessionId
sdc.daemon.SessionId.description: The name of a session, chosen by the client that opens it.
